facts.statement: The type species Miomancalla wetmorei was described by Howard in 1976.
The genus Miomancalla contains two species: M. howardi and M. wetmorei.
Miomancalla belongs to the subfamily Mancallinae.
Miomancalla is classified within the family Alcidae.
Miomancalla lived from the Tortonian to the Messinian stages, between 11.63 and 5.333 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Tortonian to Messinian (11.63 to 5.333 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are four recorded fossil occurrences of Miomancalla in the Paleobiology Database.
